roi_group_clear.effect: retire lost instances after the active count area clears; visible context tracks remain connected

transfer_policy.admission: confirmed physical instance observed in the active ROI; up to 0.40 seconds of context qualification after leaving it
transfer_policy.repeat_id: short motion memory reconnects changed tracker IDs to one physical instance
transfer_policy.defect_side_entry: exclude tracks first seen left of the defect line from admission
transfer_policy.removal: right-to-left across the separately calibrated defect exit only
transfer_policy.uncounted_defect: exclude without subtracting a different can
